$comment: Documented exceptions for packages/admin-sdk/scripts/check-openapi-parity.mjs. Every entry needs a reason. allowedMissingPaths suppresses hard errors for SDK calls the API no longer documents (broken SDK routes awaiting removal); allowedMissingSchemas suppresses schema warnings; ignoredAdminPaths lists documented admin operations the SDK intentionally does not implement yet.

schemaAliases.reason: The inventory availability endpoint documents InventoryAvailability; the SDK names the same body AvailabilityResponse.
The transfer endpoint documents TransferResponse; the SDK names the same body InventoryTransferResponse.
The inquiry unread counter documents UnreadCountResponse; the SDK names the same body InquiryUnreadCountResponse.
The notification channel test result documents TestChannelResponse; the SDK names the same body NotificationChannelTestResponse.
The inquiry form field option documents FieldOption; the SDK names the same body InquiryFieldOption.
The inquiry form draft body documents SaveInquiryDraftRequest; the SDK names the same body SaveInquiryFormDraftRequest.
The batch settings body documents SettingsRequest; the SDK names the same body SettingsUpdateRequest.
